dispatched_rule: Keep narration duration, generated source duration and intended edit duration separate. Before assigning timing, read the narration aloud or use the selected voice's actual audio when available; a structurally valid shot plan can still be too short for its text. If audio is not yet available, label timing provisional and simplify the narration or allow room in the edit. Do not speed up speech just to fit a guessed duration, loop a clip silently or invent a website duration option. A confirmed image remains the same selection only for its exact bytes; importing a local model-authorized copy must retain that hash and the approval's limited scope, without granting public or commercial rights.
